note: Adapted from the entry of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the soldier and the worker are described, the alate is recorded in the original as not known; synonymy lists, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated. The worker pronotal width is given in the OCR of the original as “0.fi3” and is recorded here as 0.63.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, darker anteriorly; antennae concolorous with the anterior part of the head; pronotum concolorous with the head, the rest of the body pale. Head sparsely setose, body moderately setose. Body length 4.75–5.00 mm. Head capsule elongate, subrectangular (to mandibular base 1.58–1.60 mm, maximum width 0.88–0.90 mm); width slightly more than half the length (width/length index 0.56). Fontanelle a minute circular point at about the anterior 1/3. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 smallest; segment 4 about as long as segment 2. Labrum wider than long, broadly rounded anteriorly (length 0.18–0.20 mm, width 0.28 mm). Mandibles short and stout, finely serrate (length 0.88–0.90 mm); slightly longer than half the head length (left mandible length/head length index 0.56). Postmentum rod-shaped; waist at the posterior 1/3 (length 0.88–0.98 mm, maximum width 0.34–0.35 mm, waist width 0.18–0.20 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin indistinctly concave, posterior margin weakly convex (length 0.28–0.30 mm, width 0.55–0.58 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to reddish brown; antennae, labrum and postclypeus pale yellow to yellowish brown. Head sparsely setose, body moderately setose. Body length 3.70–4.75 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (to mandibular base 0.85–1.00 mm, maximum width 0.80–0.95 mm). Fontanelle plate a small circular spot at the middle. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 smallest. Postclypeus inflated, slightly longer than half its width. Pronotum saddle-shaped; length 0.23–0.25 mm, width 0.45–0.63 mm.
